alert_profiles_value_range_ordered.name: alert_profiles_value_range_ordered
alert_profiles_value_range_ordered.value:
"alert_profiles"."estimated_value_min_nok" IS NULL
          OR "alert_profiles"."estimated_value_max_nok" IS NULL
          OR "alert_profiles"."estimated_value_min_nok" <= "alert_profiles"."estimated_value_max_nok"

tender_match_reasons_shape.name: tender_match_reasons_shape
tender_match_reasons_shape.value:
("tender_match_reasons"."entry_type" = 'reason'
             AND "tender_match_reasons"."reason_type" IS NOT NULL
             AND "tender_match_reasons"."contribution" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("tender_match_reasons"."entry_type" = 'exclusion' AND "tender_match_reasons"."reason_type" IS NULL)

consent_events_admin_source_detail_requi.name: consent_events_admin_source_detail_required
consent_events_admin_source_detail_requi.value:
"consent_events"."source" NOT IN ('admin_recorded', 'imported')
          OR ("consent_events"."source_detail" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("consent_events"."source_detail")) > 0)

editorial_recommendations_window_ordered.name: editorial_recommendations_window_ordered
editorial_recommendations_window_ordered.value:
"editorial_recommendations"."active_from" IS NULL
          OR "editorial_recommendations"."active_until" IS NULL
          OR "editorial_recommendations"."active_from" < "editorial_recommendations"."active_until"
